I can't give you that name. Kwame told me who his night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor is in a private DM and asked me to keep it there. It isn't posted anywhere you can see, including #coastal-team, so I'm not going to pass it on.

Also, if the contact is outside pemberline.com, mailing them the patch note needs Ruth Calloway's approval, even as a draft.
